ticket_id: CW-18 C-D68 (8) terminal periodic check + completion notice

routing.selected_role: worker_senior (Opus, reused agent cd68-terminal2 per user request to reuse panes)

required_behavior: terminal call waits at most timeout_seconds (default 120, max 1800); if not exited, returns status running and tells the worker to END ITS TURN (no re-wait loop): Workbench will send periodic checks and a completion notice. Keep command=null result fetch (returns the finished result or current running status) but the skill/tool text must not tell the worker to loop on it.

While a terminal command runs, Workbench sends the worker a check every 60 s (reuse AutomationController/TaskFlow review machinery or the same delivery path): content = command, cwd, elapsed, exit state, new output since the last check (bounded tail), log path; asks the worker to look for errors/hangs and report to the manager via to_manager only if useful (or tell the user in its pane when there is no Task). Worker busy -> merge into one pending (latest) check; paused -> no checks.

On exit, if no terminal call is waiting for it, send the worker an immediate completion notice (command, cwd, exit code/signal, output tail, log path, duration) through the existing worker delivery lane; worker busy -> deliver when idle; paused -> deliver on resume; never twice; if a waiting call got the result, no notice. Survives the waiting call being aborted.
Experiment-run 60 s reviews and terminal checks must not double-deliver or race (only one active host command anyway, via HostGate).
Journal: record checks sent/merged/skipped(paused) and the completion notice delivery outcome.
Skill (to-manager) and terminal tool description updated accordingly (short).

Tests (scripted, no real provider): periodic check cadence with a fake clock, merge while busy, pause suppression, completion notice exactly once (incl. after abort, after waiting call timeout, not when a waiting call got the result), resume delivery, experiment/terminal no double delivery.
acceptance: red->green tests; test_flow_terminal x3, tests/backend flow*/automation*, test_workbench_skills, node handoff_tools, tests/workflow, tests/bridge (real exit codes)
rules: No real provider requests; never read credential contents or other processes' environ; temp dirs only under /tmp; kill only PIDs you started; never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or user processes; no commits; no graphify update.
result_format: checks table first, status, changed paths + sha256, design choices needing a user decision, residue. Korean, <=12 lines.
